reviews.text: Tammy is very unreliable. I haven't left my dog with anyone for many years. After a nice conversation where Tammy got my trust and confidence,  we set up a meet and greet. She texted me 1 hour before to tell me she was sick and would contact me in the next few days.  I inquired how she was feeling a few days later because I believed her. I no longer do. Never heard from her again, not even to tell me she was no longer interested. After reading other reviews, it looks like I dodged a bullet. Be ware.
We had Tammy stay over the Christmas holiday with 3 of our dogs. She came over for a meet and greet and the dogs loved her. She sent daily pics and updates. Came home to happy pups. Highly recommend!

We never even got to the point of her watching my dogs.  She was highly unprofessional.  She scheduled a meet and greet with our dogs and then showed up two hours late with no apologies or even acknowledgement that she was late. I kept getting strange texts from her at 12 am......I suspect that she was drinking.  We decided to not even use her because of all the red flags.  My neighbor used her and said that she didn't even give her elderly sick dog all her medication as directed and then came home to find her washing her fine linens from Europe in the washing machine.  I suggest you keep you looking if you want professionalism because this girl isn't it.
